items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I said, since he passed away, I think that Mercer needed me more than ever, so that's the reason why I'm with the band.

ctx.x: So I went on, and I think we had an interview at Johnson Publishers in Chicago. And I said -- they interviewed me -- I said the only reason I was here was on account of Duke Ellington. I had retired, and he called me and told me to come on back. I didn't have to play. Just to sit there. He missed looking at me, seeing me. And I said that's the main reason why I came back to the band. Because I
had retired and stopped blowing. I said, since he passed away, I think that Mercer needed me more than ever, so that's the reason why I'm with the band.
That's wonderful. That's wonderful. I think that's a good note for us to end this interview on. Don't you, Cootie?
